Name: Yuki Nakamura

Work Experience:
- 2023--Present: Research Associate, Kyoto Institute of Molecular Biology. Lead experimental design and execution for projects investigating cellular response to environmental stressors. Developed and optimized protocols for RNA sequencing in plant cells, improving yield and data accuracy. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to analyze gene expression profiles using bioinformatics tools. Authored detailed reports and presented findings at internal seminars and national conferences. Mentored junior researchers and graduate students on laboratory techniques and data interpretation.
- 2022--2023: Biology Research Intern, Osaka BioTech Solutions. Assisted senior scientists in conducting experiments related to protein synthesis and folding mechanisms. Prepared biological samples and maintained cell cultures, ensuring compliance with safety standards.
